title: qRT-PCR Setup: Part 2 - Custom Reaction Set Up from CSV
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Upload required CSV files
steps.instruction: Upload the two CSV files (water/master‑mix transfers and RNA transfers) to the Opentrons app before running the protocol; these files contain all volumes, source wells, and destination wells.

steps.title: Place PCR plate on temperature module
steps.instruction: Place a 96‑well PCR plate on the temperature module and set the module to 4 °C.

steps.title: Distribute water to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Using the p20 single‑channel pipette, dispense 0–2 µL water from a single water tube into the destination wells of the PCR plate as listed in the CSV file. If the p20 single is not selected, the protocol will pause and prompt the user to perform the water transfers manually, with volumes and wells shown in a pause comment in the OT app.

steps.title: Distribute master mix to PCR plate
steps.instruction: Using the p300 single‑channel pipette, dispense up to 19 µL master mix from any source well or tube (available from up to four racks or plates) into the destination wells of the PCR plate according to the CSV file.

steps.title: Transfer and mix normalized RNA
steps.instruction: Using either the p20 single‑channel or p20 multi‑channel pipette, transfer 2–7 µL normalized RNA from source wells or columns (up to four racks or plates) into the PCR plate as specified in the CSV file. For the multi‑channel pipette, ensure that both source and destination wells are in row A of a 96‑well formatted labware. After dispensing, mix the RNA with the previously added master mix and water.
